description: Pedestrian & Cycling Cordon Counts is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This dataset presents data collected as part of Pedal Power Cordon counts which are performed annually. Details relating to the methodology used in the collection of data at each location is described in PDF documents which are accessible in the attached files of the dataset. Coverage: ACT metropolitan areas. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are bike, cycling, pedestrian, transport. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, kmz. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
